newsitem.title: UK: UK marketing sector sees merger activity growing.
newsitem.headline: UK marketing sector sees merger activity growing.

text.p: Top executives in advertising agencies and other marketing services companies in Britain expect an increase in mergers and acquisitions in their industry over the next year, according to a report released on Thursday.
WKS Results Ltd, M&A advisers, said in a study based on a recent survey that 89 percent of senior people in the multi-billion-pound marketing industry forecast a rise in mergers and acquisitions.
It said 74 percent of respondents had been involved in M&A activity of some kind, including 9.0 percent who had completed an acquisition.
The survey covered advertising, public relations, design, integrated agencies, direct marketing, sales promotion, media independents, database marketing, research and telemarketing.
The fastest-growing sectors were database marketing, expected to grow 22 percent over the next year, independent media buying and planning at 20 percent and direct marketing at 16 percent.
WKS said direct marketing and database marketing were growing at the expense of conventional advertising.

"So advertising agencies and the larger multi-disciplined groups are keen to invest in this area, whilst some owners of direct and database marketing agencies feel the time is ripe to sell at a desirable price," it said.
The report said there was an increase in merger and acquisition activity because there was an improved economic mood in the marketing services sector.
